cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Pick the Prize
cards.instruction: Make them choose which reward, principle, or relationship matters most when not everything can be kept.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Choose the trophy ceremony or our anniversary dinner. They're at the same time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then you're choosing the trophy and postponing us. Say which.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It could be a short ceremony.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you leave before your name is called? That's the choice.

mechanism: Copy calendar decline marks as confirmations, then insist on an explicit priority between conflicting ceremony and anniversary bookings.
confusable: Not simple romantic ultimatum: B2 must expose the copied declined marks and A3 mask the cancellation as deliberate choice space.
comparison: A relationship/time conflict differs from choosing how to divide a financial prize.
seedUse: Retains simultaneous anniversary dinner/trophy ceremony and refusal to disguise postponement; adds copied invitation marks.
